text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I spotted Narita Top Road
in front of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My target weight is still so far away. I gotta drop a ton of pounds!
...Alright, don't give up, me!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay not resting on your day off?
Are you sure you're okay not resting on your day off?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, well... It's kind of embarrassing, but
I ate way too much of the food gifts.

Knowing how serious she is,
I worry she might push herself too hard cutting weight on her own.
At a time like this...
choice_data_list: Mind if I join you? Actually, my weight's been...
Mind if I join you? Actually, my weight's been...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Definitely!
Exercising together sounds fresh and fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Goooal!
Running up and down these stairs is quite the workout!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You've worked up a good sweat too, Trainer!
Let's take a quick breather, and next—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Bubbly Exercise!
FOO♪ FOOO~♪ Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the beach sprint is doooone~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whew... All right!
Next up, how about some creek climbing in the nearby woods—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh, huh? Where is Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawa! A-Are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, please rest here.
I'll wrap this up in a flash and—"

To be honest, I'm utterly exhausted and near my limit.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Losing weight was supposed to be tough...
But more than that, getting to exercise together was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still...
forcing you to tag along with me is—
choice_data_list: I'm not just going along with this out of obligation, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Because your running is my running too.
Because your run is also my run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right.
I'm not running all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When training, when worrying, when feeling down,
when rejoicing... I've always, always been with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then!
Let's definitely take a little break. Together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So that we can keep running together from now on.

After continuing the weight-cut together for a while...
Narita Top Road successfully got back down to her ideal weight!
